connector.name: Eight Sleep MCP
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial Eight Sleep MCP server: read sleep trends, temperature, alarms; gated pod control.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package eight-sleep-mcp-unofficial. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: EIGHT_SLEEP_EMAIL
env.description: Eight Sleep account email. Optional when configured with eight-sleep-mcp-server setup.

env.name: EIGHT_SLEEP_PASSWORD
env.description: Eight Sleep account password. Prefer the setup command so this secret is stored in ~/.eight-sleep-mcp/config.json (chmod 600) instead of MCP client config.

env.name: EIGHT_SLEEP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
env.description: Set to true to enable write tools (set_temperature, set_side, set_away_mode, snooze/dismiss alarm). Default false (read-only).

env.name: EIGHT_SLEEP_PRIVACY_MODE
env.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured.

env.name: EIGHT_SLEEP_CACHE
env.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

env.name: EIGHT_SLEEP_TOKEN_PATH
env.description: Optional local token path. Defaults to ~/.eight-sleep-mcp/tokens.json.

env.name: EIGHT_SLEEP_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Optional override for the Android-app client_id default.

env.name: EIGHT_SLEEP_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Optional override for the Android-app client_secret default.
